Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

Hit weekly and monthly meeting quotas consistently



What We're Looking For


Minimum 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting experience in B2B

Proven track record of hitting quota—bring your numbers

Comfortable with rejection and high-volume activity

Clear, professional phone presence

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional setup

Coachable with a no-excuses attitude toward performance



Bonus Points


Experience in lead gen agencies or sales development roles

Familiarity with dialers, CRMs, and outbound tech stacks

Background calling into professional services, manufacturing, or mid-market B2B



Compensation

Base + performance bonuses tied to meetings booked. Top performers earn significantly more. Details discussed during interviews.


How to Apply

  • Follow our Linkedin Company Page and our Founder Enzo Carasso before applying so we can see that actually read the entire Job Description.
  • Once you've completed the above - send a connection request to Enzo Carasso with a short note on why you're a fit. Include your last 3 months of performance metrics if available-conversion rates, dials per day, meetings booked. No fluff, just results.

title: Recruiting Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Recruitment Manager to join our Recruiting Team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. This person must be proactive, detail-oriented, and demonstrate excellent analytical abilities, as well as teamwork and multitasking skills. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry! to accompany our strategic growth objectives in hiring personnel and key roles.

- Provide new ideas and solutions aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the selection processes, methods, and technology.

title: Liferay Developer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


  • Note: This is a 3-month contract position with the possibility of extension , based on performance and project needs.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • 6+ years of professional experience working with Java-based platforms .
  • Hands-on experience with Liferay DXP as both administrator and developer.
  • Proven experience performing Liferay upgrades, deployments, and DevOps-related tasks .
  • Strong fundamentals in Java, JSP, and Portlet development .
  • Experience integrating Okta with Liferay , including OIDC-based authentication and user synchronization .
  • Solid background in performance tuning and remediation of technical debt in enterprise portals.

Brazil (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled SAP ABAP Developer to join our team for a strategic spin-off initiative. This role involves designing, developing, and maintaining custom SAP applications and enhancements to support the separation of business units and ensure seamless system functionality during and after the transition.

  • Strong knowledge of SAP SD module.
  • Experience with ALV reports, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, SmartForms, Adobe Forms, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced project environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in spin-off related SAP projects.
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Exposure to SAP PI/PO or CPI integration tools.
  • Agile or hybrid project methodology experience.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Decskill was founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company and their main mission is to delivery value through the knowledge. We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.


DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:

• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.


Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.


We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer for a remote project in Brazil.


What You’ll Do:


  • Develop and maintain robust web applications using .NET Core and Angular
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver high-quality solutions
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code
  • Participate in architectural discussions and code reviews
  • Continuously improve our systems and processes


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6+ years of professional experience in .NET development
  • Strong skills in Angular (latest versions preferred)
  • Solid understanding of C#, REST APIs, Entity Framework, and SQL
  • Experience with Azure , CI/CD pipelines , and microservices is a plus
  • Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)
  • Team player with a proactive and problem-solving mindset


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference “DA/.NETBR” .


Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master(Supply chain)
description:
Remote Role Business Analyst & Scrum Master

Assignment length 1 year

Max Bill Rate: Will depend on years of experience (5–8+ years in analytics/BA roles; 3–5+ years Scrum Master experience.

Worker MUST be based in São Paulo, Brazil


We are hiring for our USA Client; payment is USD; Monthly Pay, No Benefits

Candidate need to have a short notice period

Candidate need to use their personal computer for work

Candidate need to have an excellent English communication skills


About the Role

We’re seeking a Business Analyst & Scrum Master to help drive the delivery of our Supply Chain Analytics product teams. You’ll partner with planning, logistics, and manufacturing domain leaders to translate business needs into actionable insights, while facilitating agile delivery for a set of cross-functional teams.


Key Responsibilities:

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

• Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders (Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, Customer Service) to elicit requirements, define user stories, and map processes.

• Translate business problems into analytics solutions (dashboards, KPIs, data marts, alerts) aligned to product vision and roadmap.

• Create and maintain artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps (BPMN), data dictionaries, and data lineage.

• Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake, write performant SQL (CTEs, window functions), validate data quality, and reconcile with source systems.

• Review Power BI reports and semantic models; review row-level security (RLS), calculation groups, and DAX measures.

• Define and monitor KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory turns, case fill rate, OTIF, production adherence, DC throughput, transportation cost per case).

• Support data governance (metadata, access controls, quality rules) and contribute to analytics best practices.


Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

• Serve as Scrum Master for the product team: facilitate daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

• Coach the team in agile principles (empiricism, transparency, iterative delivery) and help remove impediments.

• Maintain a healthy backlog and sprint cadence; utilize velocity and cycle time to forecast delivery.

• Foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, and platform teams (Snowflake, CI/CD, security).

• Promote definition of ready/done, test automation where applicable, and measurable outcomes per sprint/release.

• Track and communicate progress via roadmaps, burnup/burndown, and stakeholder updates.


Qualifications

• 5–8+ years in analytics/BA roles; 3–5+ years Scrum Master experience.

• Proficiency in Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, modeling).

• Strong grounding in data modeling, ETL/ELT, and data quality.

• CPG supply chain experience (demand, inventory, production, logistics).

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills.


Preferred

• CSM/PSM, PL-300, SnowPro Core

• SAP/Blue Yonder/Kinaxis exposure

• Familiarity with S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP/ECC/S4), TMS/WMS data structures and integration patterns.

• Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g., data quality rules, stewardship, cataloging)


Tools & Environment

• Snowflake, SQL

• Power BI (Desktop & Service)

• Azure DevOps (work management)

• Data Catalog/Governance (e.g., Collibra or internal)

• ERP/APS/TMS/WMS integrations (SAP, Blue Yonder, etc.)


What You’ll Impact

• Service levels (case fill, OTIF), inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve.

• Data product reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption.

title: Assessor de Investimentos JR.
description:
Sobre nós


Fundada em 1997 na Coreia do Sul e presente em 19 países, a Mirae Asset é um conglomerado financeiro global que oferece soluções de investimento inovadoras para clientes ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, atuamos como corretora de valores, conectando o mercado local a nossa presença internacional e colocando à disposição de investidores pessoas físicas e institucionais produtos e serviços de primeira linha. Nosso compromisso é unir solidez global, inovação e proximidade no atendimento para apoiar nossos clientes em seus objetivos de investimento.


#VemSerMiraeAsset



Assessor de Investimentos Jr (Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres)



Descrição:


Profissional de Assessoria de Investimentos responsável pela gestão e relacionamento de uma carteira de aproximadamente 500 clientes do segmento varejo. Atuação com forte foco no cliente, orientação à performance e atingimento de metas, aliando intensidade comercial à identificação contínua de oportunidades de investimento dentro da base ativa.

Espera-se que o(a) profissional tenha capacidade analítica e comercial para mapear oportunidades de negócios, contribuir para o aumento de volume sob custódia, captação líquida e geração de valor para os clientes e para a companhia.


Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o relacionamento com uma carteira de cerca de 500 clientes varejo.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o perfil, objetivos e necessidades dos clientes.
  • Identificar oportunidades de investimento e de alocação dentro da base ativa.
  • Realizar ações comerciais recorrentes visando as metas relacionadas a captação.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho da carteira e propor ajustes de acordo com o cenário de mercado.
  • Atuar com foco em metas individuais e coletivas, contribuindo para os resultados da área.
  • Manter registros e interações atualizadas nos sistemas internos (CRM e plataformas).
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com mesas de operações, produtos e demais áreas de suporte.


Requisitos


  • Certificação obrigatória: CPA-20
  • Formação em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em produtos de investimento (renda fixa, renda variável, fundos, etc.).
  • Perfil comercial, com boa comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento.
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente ou área comercial no mercado financeiro.


Diferenciais


  • CEA será um diferencial
  • Experiência prévia com carteira de clientes varejo.
  • Vivência em plataformas digitais de investimentos.
  • Conhecimento de CRM e ferramentas de gestão comercial.


Benefícios: Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação, Assistência Médica, Seguro Vida, Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento, Reembolso idiomas, Reembolso odontológico, Wellhub e PLR.


Local: Avenida Brigadeiro Faria Lima – Itaim Bibi – SP

title: Analista Sênior de Omnicanalidade - Foco em Integração de Canais & Experiência do Cliente
description:
Vaga: Analista Sênior de Omnicanalidade – Foco em Integração de Canais & Experiência do Cliente

Local: Escritório Lapa – SP | 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de entrar em quadra com a gente!

Na Centauro, acreditamos no poder do varejo conectado para transformar a experiência do nosso cliente. Jogamos junto com todas as áreas para integrar canais, melhorar processos e entregar uma jornada fluida e memorável. Buscamos alguém analítico, com pensamento estratégico e foco em performance para fortalecer nosso time de Omnicanalidade. Estamos procurando um(a) Analista Sênior de Omnicanalidade para liderar análises, otimizar processos e atuar como ponte entre áreas, garantindo que a experiência do cliente seja consistente e eficiente em todos os nossos canais – físicos e digitais.


Seus desafios no jogo:

• Mapear e otimizar a jornada omnichannel do cliente, conectando loja física, e-commerce, app, WhatsApp, marketplaces e outros canais de forma fluida e estratégica;

• Monitorar indicadores como NPS, OTIF, taxa de retirada, conversão cross-channel, devoluções e SLA de entrega, traduzindo dados em ações de melhoria;

• Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios avançados em Power BI, com extração e modelagem de dados via SQL e BigQuery;

• Identificar e propor melhorias em processos como Ship from Store, Click & Collect, Entrega via Loja e Troca Omnichannel;

• Atuar em parceria com áreas como Logística, Tecnologia, Comercial, Atendimento, Produtos Digitais e Lojas para garantir integração das operações;

• Apoiar testes e validações em sistemas como OMS, POS e WMS, acompanhando performance e aderência;

• Conduzir análises ad hoc e apoiar projetos estratégicos voltados à experiência e à eficiência operacional;

• Apoiar treinamentos e padronizações operacionais nas frentes omnichannel.


Esperamos que você tenha:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Tecnologia da Informação, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência prévia em operações omnichannel no varejo ou e-commerce;

• Domínio avançado de Power BI, SQL e BigQuery para análises e tomada de decisão;

• Vivência com ferramentas como OMS, ERP, CRM e plataformas de e-commerce (Linx, VTEX, Salesforce, TOTVS, etc.);

• Capacidade de gerar insights acionáveis a partir de grandes volumes de dados, com foco em performance e cliente.


Vai ser um golaço se você também tiver:

• Conhecimento em metodologias de CX, UX e Design Thinking;

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de tracking e análise de jornada digital (Google Analytics, tagueamento, etc.);

• Participação em projetos de transformação digital e integração de canais.


Competências que fazem a diferença:

• Raciocínio analítico e visão sistêmica;

• Proatividade, senso de dono e orientação para resultado;

• Boa articulação com diferentes áreas e influência sem autoridade;

• Organização e disciplina para garantir a excelência nos processos.


O que você encontra por aqui:

• Um time que acredita na potência da integração entre canais para transformar a experiência de compra;

• Liberdade para propor, testar e construir com autonomia;

• Um ambiente dinâmico, com muita troca, desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento.


Se você curte trabalhar com dados, integração de canais e experiência do cliente, vem jogar com a gente!

title: CONSULTOR(A) CIENTISTA DADOS II
description:
QUEM SOMOS?


Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.


PLURAL


Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!



DADOS:


GS: 17

Local: Jacareí / SP (Hibrido)

Inscrições até: 06/11/2025



O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


  • Criar modelos e ensembles de modelos usando técnicas combinadas de Machine Learning, estatística e otimização para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Criar ferramentas com o foco no aumento da produtividade do time em atividades críticas de Machine Learning, como pré-processamento, criação dos modelos e deploy;
  • Interpretar resultados e gerar visualizações e conclusões de análises que construam histórias relevantes e conjunto de ações para a organização;
  • Construir forte relacionamento com diversas áreas internas a empresa de modo a garantir entendimento compreensivo dos requisitos do negócio;
  • Trabalhar em modelo ágil e de forma colaborativa dentro de squads;
  • Orientar o time com metodologia, ferramenta e conhecimento para soluções de problemas com Machine Learning;
  • Definir melhores práticas de Gestão de Dados e Gestão do Código para garantindo pontualidade e rigor nas soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Fazer a conexão entre problemas de negócio e oportunidades analíticas, sendo capaz de estimar benefícios para o negócio;
  • Ser capaz de comunicar de forma profissional e objetivo os benefícios e alavancas dos produtos digitais para especialistas do negócio em vários níveis de senioridade;
  • Liderar tecnicamente um dos domínios de ciência de dados (Otimização, Visão Computacional, NLP, etc) entre as tribos, definindo requisitos, tecnologias e melhores práticas;
  • Construir e gerenciar análises de múltiplas bases de dados de grande volume (ex. base de transações, vendedores, clientes) usando diversas ferramentas técnicas (SQL, R, Python, Excel) para criar análises fundadas com qualidade e rigor;
  • Desenvolver modelos de otimização linear inteira, inteira mista, algoritmos evolutivos modelos utilizando técnicas de Inteligência Artificial para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Definir o frame do problema, suas features e a melhor forma de criar modelos para soluções de problemas;
  • Criar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs em serviços de cloud ou on-premise;
  • Definir junto com times de TI requisitos de Arquitetura, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir robustez e automação nas soluções desenvolvidas.


QUEM NOS INSPIRA?


  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.



O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?


  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas STEM (estatística, tecnologia, engenharias ou matemática);
  • Sólida experiencia na área de ciência de dados – Modelagem e/ou projetos de otimização;
  • Experiencia com métodos analíticos avançados (ex. Machine Learning/ Deep Learning / Otimização, entre outros);
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias e linguagens de programação como Python, R e SQL;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura e serviços de cloud, como: Containers, Virtural Machines, bancos de dados no-sql, integração;
  • Experiência em programação e uso de linguagem como Python e/ou R Experiência em ferramentas de programação como Python para publicar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs seja na nuvem ou on-premises;
  • Experiência no uso em ferramentas de colaboração e versionamento de códigos;
  • Experiência em esteiras de CI/CD (Azure pipelines, Github Actions, etc);
  • Experiência em modelos de otimização exatos e/ou heurísticas na solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento técnico: estatística avançada e análises e conceitos financeiros avançados;
  • Cinco anos de experiência de trabalho com análises, modelagem preditiva e interpretação de dados ou similares na área;
  • Será feito um teste na forma de case ou prova online para que o candidato demonstre habilidades na área
  • Vivencia no segmento industrial será considerado um diferencial;
  • Desejável especialização ou pós graduação na área de machine learning, estatística ou pesquisa operacional;
  • Desejável Dois ou mais anos de experiência em Consultoria Estratégica e/ou Serviços Financeiros;
  • Desejável inglês avançado.




NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!


PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.


SUZANO FAZ BEM


O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior DevOps Engineer


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Design and implement deployment pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Gitlab, Ansible, Puppet, or similar to automate building, testing, and deployment processes
  • Manage and maintain the infrastructure for deployment pipelines, including servers, databases, load balancers, and other resources
  • Monitor the performance of applications deployed in production environments and troubleshoot any issues that arise
  • Ensure the security and compliance of the deployment process and applications, including implementing security measures such as SSL certificates, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems
  • Collaborate with developers to understand requirements, ensure alignment with the development process, and support successful deployment
  • Continuously improve deployment processes through automation, identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains
  • Provide support to customers and end-users as needed, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to deployed applications
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and timely deployment of software applications
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for our platform
  • Have the ability and flexibility to work with teams globally, across time zones


What you’ll have

  • 5+ years of experience in a deployment role Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management OR 7+ years of experience in a deployment role with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Certification in any of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP or K8
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications in any one of the clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with Dockers or similar and experience with Kubernetes or similar
  • Strong technical skills in automation, continuous integration, and deployment practices
  • Working knowledge with Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
  • Administration of databases (MS SQL, Mongo)
  • Working knowledge with Linux and Windows operating systems


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Business Analyst to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content. No prior AI experience is required for this role.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

  • Experience with the MERN stack and at least 1 other mainstream technology stack

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms
  • Understanding of information security best practices
  • Proven ability to work both independently as an individual contributor and collaboratively as part of a team

  • The unique opportunity to join and help shape a brand new team within an established global company

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) / Analytics Engineer


A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) para atuar na construção, organização e otimização de pipelines analíticos, modelos de transformação, governança de dados e camadas de consumo. Essa função combina engenharia, analytics e visão de produto — ideal para profissionais que transitam com fluidez entre dados, negócio e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir pipelines de transformação utilizando DBT com testes, documentação e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines complexos em Airflow.
  • Criar e otimizar estruturas em BigQuery com foco em performance e eficiência de custos.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e análises em Looker Platform, garantindo coerência entre métricas e modelos.
  • Atuar próximo a times de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções analíticas.
  • Garantir organização, padronização e governança das camadas de dados.
  • Automação de processos e validações utilizando Python (quando aplicável).
  • Acompanhar, investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados a dados e pipelines.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e padrões de forma clara e escalável.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a), Engenheiro(a) de BI ou função similar.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo modelagem relacional e dimensional.
  • Experiência avançada com DBT para construção e gestão de pipelines de transformação.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • GCP – BigQuery : conhecimento profundo de performance, otimização de custos e recursos avançados.
  • Familiaridade com serviços de dados do GCP (ex.: Cloud Storage).
  • Experiência com Looker Platform para criação de dashboards e análises.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis/Consultivos)

  • Perfil consultivo: capacidade de dialogar com áreas não técnicas e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade para análise de causa-raiz e construção de insights.
  • Cultura forte de documentação, governança e padronização de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises exploratórias.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de negócio (Opcional): AARRR, LTV, CAC, métricas financeiras.


Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, autonomia e alto rigor técnico.
  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido ou Remoto (ajustável conforme projeto)


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA: Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

title: Head of School
description:
This role will be located in a school in Brazil; it is not remote


As International Schools Partnership increases its presence across Brazil, we are seeking Principals, Aspiring Principals, and Senior Leaders with strong K-12 experience and a track record of driving whole-school improvement. This is an opportunity for leaders who are passionate about Academic Excellence and who bring an operational and commercially minded approach to running high-quality schools.

Join a global network committed to empowering school leaders, encouraging innovation, and positively shaping learning communities throughout Brazil.

About International Schools Partnership

International Schools Partnership is a leading and growing group of 114 private international schools operating in 25 countries and educating over 92,500 students worldwide.

Our role is to support and enable our schools to become the schools of choice in their local communities and the global education sector. We strive to grow schools renowned for setting new standards of excellence in education, cultivating future-ready students and enriching the communities they serve.

Why choose International Schools Partnership to be your career of choice?

  • Global Outlook: Lead in an environment that promotes cultural awareness and international collaboration.
  • Commitment to Excellence: Join a group dedicated to delivering high-quality teaching and learning.
  • Modern Learning Environments: Work in innovative and well-resourced facilities designed for progressive education.
  • Leadership Growth: Benefit from continuous professional development and global leadership pathways.


Purpose of Role

The Principal leads with vision and integrity, fostering a safe, inclusive, and supportive school culture where learning thrives. By working collaboratively with their team, parents, and the wider International Schools Partnership network, they position the school as a “School of Choice” that delivers exceptional learning experiences and outcomes, translating into increased enrolment growth and higher student retention. Their responsibilities span safeguarding, driving teaching quality through evidence-based improvement, strategic planning, community engagement, and commercial performance. Parents/carers and students recognise and endorse the school for academic excellence, and teachers’ professional learning and development thrives under their stewardship of the school. The Principal reports to the Regional Managing Director (RMD).

Key Responsibilities

All sections are weighted equally at 25% from a performance perspective.

  • People Development and Wellbeing
  • Student Learning Outcomes
  • Grow Community and Deliver Exceptional Customer Service and Experience
  • Commercial Success


Key Skills

Strategic planning

Educational leadership

Safeguarding and Child Protection management

Inclusive leadership

Emotional intelligence

Building community

Stakeholder engagement

Team development

Performance management

Engaging communication

Data-driven decision-making

Marketing insights

Financial acumen

Change management

Collaborative mindset

Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

International Schools Partnership is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

International Schools Partnership is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of International Schools Partnership through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em

Esquema de trabalho: Remoto - com viagens.


Principais atividades:


  • Utiliza o conhecimento das competências e da estratégia de negócios da empresa para garantir novas oportunidades de negócios com clientes existentes e potenciais, de acordo com os planos e programas de marketing da empresa.
  • Identifica parcerias importantes que impulsionarão os negócios futuros.
  • Negocia acordos comerciais importantes.
  • Estabelece análises competitivas, identifica tendências e articula o impacto potencial em áreas específicas do negócio.
  • Apresenta análises de casos de negócios à gerência executiva.
  • Trabalha com os clientes atuais para identificar e atender às necessidades, resolver reclamações e verificar a satisfação do cliente.
  • Mantém contato frequente com as operações relativas às obrigações contratuais atuais e trabalha com a equipe para estabelecer ferramentas de comunicação eficazes.
  • Trabalha em conjunto com outras unidades de negócios no que se refere ao desenvolvimento de negócios e iniciativas da empresa.
  • Trabalha em estreita colaboração com outros funcionários de desenvolvimento de negócios para garantir que os principais objetivos e prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Participa de convenções, seminários e outras atividades comerciais para promover a GP junto a clientes, clientes potenciais e fornecedores.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de negócios, vendas B2B ou gestão de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento de análise de mercado, tendências e cenário competitivo.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e software de gestão comercial.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Espanhol avançado será uma vantagem.
  • Experiência anterior na área comercial de consultoria - desejável.


Outras habilidades:


  • Fortes habilidades de negociação para estabelecer acordos comerciais vantajosos.
  • Capacidade de construir parcerias estratégicas e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Mentalidade analítica para apresentar estudos de caso e análises de viabilidade à liderança.
  • Orientado para resultados, com foco em metas comerciais e satisfação do cliente.


Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.
